stem.text: P and Q are fixed points at the end of a string. A transverse stationary wave of constant maximum amplitude is formed on the string.

stem.alt: Horizontal line with points P, S, R, T and Q marked, and two double-headed arrows above S to R and R to T, each labelled x.

stem.text: P, R and Q are the only points on the string where nodes are formed. S and T are two points on the string at a distance $x$ from R.
What is the relationship between points S and T?

A.text: the same amplitude and in phase

C.text: the same amplitude and a phase difference of $180^{\circ}$

D.text: different amplitudes and a phase difference of $180^{\circ}$
